newsitem.title: GERMANY: Henkel shares up as Loctite merger clears.
newsitem.headline: Henkel shares up as Loctite merger clears.

text.p: Shares in German speciality chemicals group Henkel KGaA climbed strongly on Friday after the company said it had received clearance from the German Federal Cartel Office for its pending acquisition of U.S. adhesives maker Loctite Corp.
The stock was also boosted by news out after Thursday's bourse close that the group plans to acquire the remaining 23 percent of consumer products group Hans Schwarzkopf it does not already own.

Henkel preference shares were the biggest gainer on the DAX index of 30 top German shares, gaining over five percent to hit a day high of 77.50 marks, before slipping back slightly to stand up 2.70 marks at 76.30 by 1112 GMT.
Meanwhile, the DAX index was also ahead, up 1.53 percent at 2,850.62 points.
"Both the news that the Henkel-Loctite deal has been cleared and about Schwarzkopf are helping the stock," said one dealer.
